acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass shares photos (on the radio) of his family vacation in Hawaii. He poses the question: What can families do on vacation that make them feel closer?

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Writer/singer/performer Sandra Tsing Loh reads a story about a family vacation arranged by her mother, who believed that vacations couldn't be merely for leisure—they had to be educational. Which is how the family ended up vacationing in...Ethiopia.

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Contributor David Sedaris tells a story about discovering the possibilities—and pitfalls—of travel by hitchhiking.

songs.t: If You Wanna Get to Heaven
